item.title: Redfin rolls out ChatGPT app for real estate searches

item.description: A federal judge denied Compass’s motion to block Zillow’s listing access policy, allowing enforcement as the antitrust case continues.

item.description: Reverse mortgage borrowers to receive $11.5 million after CFPB found illegal servicing practices by NOVAD and Sutherland.

item.title: House scales back proposed VA mortgage fee hike
item.description: House lawmakers amend a veterans-related bill to avoid higher VA purchase loan fees while targeting refinance and assumption charges instead.

item.title: Hanna, Windermere and three more brokerages settle home seller commission lawsuits
item.description: Judge Bough approves $39.7M in settlements for five brokerages, impacting 2.7M claims in nationwide commission lawsuit.

item.title: Realtor.com Q2 revenue rises 10% as visitor traffic outpaces rivals
item.description: Realtor.com’s Q2 revenue rose 10% to $143 million as site traffic surged and the firm expanded AI and agent tools.
